text: おとくな　けいじばんに　かいて　あったこと　まねして　かいて　みたの！

structure.jp: おとくな　けいじばんに　かいて　あったこと
structure.en: what was written on the handy notice board

structure.jp: まねして　かいて　みたの！
structure.en: I tried copying it and writing it!

patterns.name: 〜てある
patterns.explanation: てある after a verb says someone did it and the result is still there. かいて　あった = 'was written there'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means 'try doing it and see'. かいて　みた = 'I tried writing'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おとくな　けいじばんに　かいて　あったこと
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in あった sits right before こと 'thing' and describes it. けいじばんに　かいて　あったこと = 'the thing that was written on the notice board'.
